business_problem: With more than 5,000 new hires each year, ADT wanted a more consistent employee experience, more manager time for their teams, and less integration work across HR systems.
solution_summary: ADT selected Oracle Cloud HCM to bring HR processes and data together on one platform, reduce integration work across its systems, and apply AI to employee and manager workflows. Within HCM, AI automatically answers routine HR inquiries, AI-assisted tools help managers complete performance reviews, and a predictive turnover model helps leaders identify potential attrition risks by job group and location. The source reports that the platform answers 90 percent of basic HR inquiries automatically, reduces HR support tickets by 26 percent, and saves managers two to three hours per direct report during performance review cycles. It does not describe upstream data feeds, integration endpoints, model design, storage architecture, or a separate serving channel, so those technical details are not inferred.

evidence_quotes: With more than 5,000 new hires each year, ADT wanted to give employees a more consistent experience, allow managers to spend more time with their teams, and reduce integration work across its systems.
With the AI capabilities in Oracle Cloud HCM, ADT has been able to automate responses to 90 percent of basic HR inquiries.
Oracle Cloud HCM has enabled ADT to reduce HR support tickets by 26 percent.
The AI-assisted tools in Oracle Cloud HCM save two to three hours per direct report during performance review cycles.
ADT has also built a predictive turnover model in Oracle Cloud HCM that helps leaders identify potential attrition risks by job group and location.
